args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Ironbark Tooling newsletter "Cold-chain logistics in 2026", its linked article, and the article's companion piece:

- Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: pilots cut claims by a quarter (25%).
